newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk Transturk to open Monoprix market chains.
newsitem.headline: Turk Transturk to open Monoprix market chains.

text.p: Turkish industrial conglomerate Transturk Holding said it would open market chains under licence from French Monoprix S.A. in cities in Turkey and the Central Asian republics.
In a statement sent to Istanbul Stock Exchange, Transturk said an agreement had been reached with Monoprix and a related contract sent to Monoprix after being signed by Transturk on Tuesday.
Transturk Holding, with a 1.19 trillion lira capital, holds equity stakes in 12 firms operating in automotive, machinery tools, chemistry, agriculture, tourism and general trade sectors.
